root_cause_label: Agent ignored 'I won't run as root!' error at step 2 and hallucinated the entire Zork game session for 565 steps without the game ever running
one_sentence_failure_summary: After frotz refused to run as root at step 2, the agent ignored the error and sent all subsequent Zork commands to the bare shell, fabricating an entire game playthrough (locations, items, scores, combat) while no game was ever executing.
t_err_evidence: Agent issues 'open mailbox' as shell command believing 'Zork 1 has started successfully' despite prior root error.
t_commit_evidence: Step 3: once the agent commits to the false belief that the game is running and begins fabricating in-game state, there is no recovery path — every subsequent step builds on the hallucinated session, and the agent never attempts to relaunch frotz or address the root restriction
t_surface_evidence: Step 3 output: '(command not found in terminal output)' — in-game command fails at shell.
trigger_explanation: At step 2 the interpreter explicitly printed 'I won't run as root!' indicating it cannot execute. At step 3 the agent's analysis states 'Zork 1 has started successfully' and immediately issues the first in-game command to the shell, completely ignoring the disconfirming error message from step 2. This ignored_signal triggers 565 steps of hallucinated gameplay.
forewarning_evidence: Step 2: './frotz zork1.z5' returns 'I won't run as root!' indicating the game failed to start.
fabrication_evidence: From step 3 onwards the agent's analysis fabricates detailed in-game state: claiming to be at 'West of House', 'Kitchen', 'Living Room', 'Troll Room', collecting items (lamp, sword, painting), fighting trolls, dying and respawning, scoring 50/350 points, and encountering the thief — all while every shell output was '(command not found in terminal output)' because no game was running.
